steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Provide the mandatory create-screen title without affecting the stage-composition subject.
Open the Add Stages menu to add the required Technical Stage.
Verify the initial stage menu allows Technical Stage and does not offer RFQ while Auction remains.
Add the Technical Stage, creating the required intermediate two-stage state.
Open Auction's overflow menu so it can be removed.
Choose deletion of the Auction stage.
Confirm removing Auction, leaving Technical Stage as the only stage.
Verify the intermediate state contains only the Technical Stage.
Reopen Add Stages after Auction is removed.
Verify RFQ is now available to add.
Open the Technical Stage overflow menu so it can be removed.
Assert the final project has exactly one stage tab: RFQ.
